title: 第23章 倒春寒第24章 洪水
content_zh:
不知过了多久，黑蛇又一次在焦渴中苏醒。
视线清晰后愣住，茫然看着白茫茫雾气，积雪未融，洞内干燥，弥漫的白雾从何而来？
好极了，出现新的忧愁，有利于成长。
犹豫是否外出找水喝。
然而浑身的滞涩正在加剧，催促立刻饮水，煎熬难耐根本无从安睡。
记不清以前有没有遇到这种困扰，总之非常不适应。
无奈，只能选择再次外出，想起上次与莽撞野猪的遭遇，希望此番出行能安安静静饮水。
熟练游出洞口，外面气温不算太冷，雪留不住，只余背阴坡还覆着些残白。
选择干燥的阳坡下山，在冰面搜寻片刻，发现石头与冰的交界处，因些许暖意而融出了涓流，便安然俯首细细啜饮。
此番饮水波澜不惊，未有任何意外遭遇。
循原路返回时洞中浓雾已然稀薄，未作多想，盘起身躯再度沉入冬眠。
月圆夜照例攀上崖顶，昂首望月呼吸，想着让自己的头颅更有力量。
若干时日后，再次从干渴中醒来……
到底发生了什么？
洞窟内弥漫着潮湿雾气，即便脑子再混沌也明白不正常，但找不到缘由，没办法，只能被干渴驱使下山饮水。
匆匆下山，上次饮水处没有流水，只得换个新地方，并贪婪多喝一些。
匆匆返回洞窟冬眠。
再次因干渴苏醒，望着浓雾，内心忧虑茫然。
加快速度下山喝水，再一阵风似的疾速卷回洞窟，与往常相同，每次外出回来都能发现雾气变淡，而且睡一觉又复归白茫茫。
睡觉，口渴，下山，上山……

零散冬眠直至初春化冻，脑袋供血增多，终于将洞窟里弥漫的浓雾，与自身频繁干渴联系起来。
黑蛇怀疑洞内不散的雾气源头是自己，失去的水分生成了白雾。
然而对过程一无所知，就很无奈。
索性不睡了，一旦过度缺水就无法平安蜕皮，难逃被困死在旧蜕中。
离开洞窟，来到谷底。
往日熟悉的小溪仍封于冰下，融水在冰上流淌。
饮下足够多的水，以热感应描摹着阳坡，观察山石与气流的温度变化，在脑中构成一幅无声的流动画面，轻易发现温暖无风处位置。
快速游弋而至，将这处宝地霸占。
盘起身躯蛰伏于此，只待春风催绿，山野草木萌发。
春寒料峭，尚未到狩猎的时候，黑蛇压下其余杂念，专注思索睡眠时白雾与焦渴问题，必须解开这个谜团，避免不明不白的风干成蛇干。
另外，还要……什么来着？对，要让脑袋长大些，更有力气才行。
其它忧虑好像记不住了。
黑蛇猜想白雾就是自己失去的水，所以需再经历一次水分流失，弄清水分流失的过程。
暖阳和煦，黑蛇努力控制着自己的意识，徘徊在睡与醒的边缘，在半睡半醒间捕捉水分流失的过程。
念头虽轻巧，实践却沉重，意识在临界点根本站不稳。
稍一绷紧，便彻底惊醒，略一松弛，便坠入沉眠。
恍惚了一会儿，视野朦胧，看见周遭弥漫着苍白的雾气，同时躯体干渴需要饮水。
得，白忙活了，下山去喝水……
孤岩小院。
迟客眯眼望向山坳。
content_en:
After an unknown amount of time, the black snake woke up from thirst again.
After my vision cleared, I was stunned. I looked blankly at the white fog. The snow had not melted and the cave was dry. Where did the diffuse white fog come from?
Great, the emergence of new sorrows is conducive to growth.
Hesitant to go out in search of water.
However, the stagnation all over my body was getting worse, and I was urged to drink water immediately. The suffering was so unbearable that I couldn't sleep peacefully.
I can’t remember if I’ve encountered this kind of trouble before, but it’s very uncomfortable.
I had no choice but to go out again. I remembered my last encounter with the reckless wild boar and hoped that I could drink water in peace during this trip.
After skillfully swimming out of the cave entrance, the temperature outside was not too cold and the snow could not be retained. Only the shady slope was still covered with some residual white.
I chose a dry sunny slope to go down the mountain and searched for a while on the ice. I found a trickle of water melting at the junction of the stone and the ice due to a little warmth, so I bowed my head and sipped it calmly.
This drinking session was uneventful and there were no unexpected encounters.
When we returned along the original path, the dense fog in the cave had already thinned. Without thinking much, we curled up and fell into hibernation again.
On a full moon night, I climbed to the top of the cliff as usual, looked up at the moon and breathed, thinking to make my head more powerful.
A few days later, I woke up from thirst again...
What happened?
The cave was filled with damp mist. No matter how confused my mind was, I knew something was wrong, but I couldn't find the reason and had no choice but to go down the mountain to drink water due to thirst.
I hurried down the mountain. There was no running water at the last drinking place, so I had to find a new place and drink more greedily.
Hurry back to the cave to hibernate.
I woke up again due to thirst, looking at the thick fog, feeling worried and confused.
I speeded down the mountain to drink water, and then quickly swept back to the cave like a gust of wind. As usual, every time I came back from an outing, I found that the fog became lighter, and it returned to white after a good sleep.
Sleeping, thirsty, going down the mountain, going up the mountain...
After hibernating in pieces until the early spring thaw, the blood supply to the brain increased, and he finally connected the thick fog that filled the cave with his frequent thirst.
Black Snake suspected that the source of the fog that persisted in the cave was itself, and the lost water generated white mist.
However, if you don’t know anything about the process, you are helpless.
Simply don't sleep. Once there is excessive lack of water, you will not be able to shed your skin safely, and you will inevitably be trapped and die in the old shed.
Leave the cave and come to the bottom of the valley.
The familiar creeks of the past are still sealed under the ice, and melt water flows on the ice.
Drink enough water, trace the sunny slope with thermal induction, observe the temperature changes of rocks and airflow, form a silent flowing picture in your mind, and easily find the location of a warm and windless place.
Cruise over quickly and seize this treasure.
He curled up and lay dormant here, just waiting for the spring breeze to turn green and the mountains and grass to sprout.
It was cold in spring, and it was not yet time for hunting. Black Snake suppressed other distracting thoughts and concentrated on the problem of white mist and thirst during sleep. He must solve this mystery to avoid the unknown drying of snakes.
In addition, what else is needed? Yes, I need to make my head bigger and stronger.
I can’t seem to remember other worries.
Black Snake guessed that the white mist was the water it had lost, so it needed to experience water loss again to understand the process of water loss.
Under the warm sun, Black Snake struggled to control his consciousness, hovering on the edge between sleep and wakefulness, capturing the process of water loss between half-asleep and half-awake.
Although the idea is light, the practice is heavy, and the consciousness cannot stand firm at the critical point.
A little tension, and you'll wake up completely; a little relaxation, and you'll fall into a deep sleep.
I was in a daze for a while, my vision was hazy, and I saw a pale mist filling the surroundings. At the same time, my body was thirsty and needed water.
Okay, all your work is in vain, go down the mountain to drink water...
Lonely Rock Courtyard.
Chi Ke squinted his eyes and looked at the col.
